{{Quote|We stay neutral, so you don't have to.|Addalar Hyland's company motto|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Addalar Hyland''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Species" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] who founded [[Galactic Solutions Industries]], a personal weapons manufacturing company, on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3642 BBY]] as the [[Galactic War]] erupted. He also had a relative named [[Arnell Hyland]] who he employed at [[Galactic Solutions Industries Headquarters|GSI Headquarters]].<ref name="Codex" /> The entrepreneur also founded [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] (THORN), in hopes of eradicating the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; however, few were aware that Hyland had lost two of his children to the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The loss of his children led him to divert a great deal of wealth to THORN in hopes of eliminating the plague.<ref name="THORN" />
